title: A meaningful principle allows personal depth

captions.energy: Seeking a valued principle’s substantial foundations
captions.emotions: Feeling a need for independent depth

meaning: Ending a narrow formula can deepen your shared view while leaving each person space to understand a principle’s substantial meaning.
text: A principle’s value can unfold after its narrow habitual form ends. The Hierophant in the energy position of Ajna supports seeking substantial foundations. Death in the physical position ends an exhausted formula of understanding. The Hermit in emotions feels a need for independent depth. Your view can preserve an important thought without requiring an immediate identical result from each person, allowing attention to have a personal subject as well as a shared direction.

For example, you discuss a museum visit. You previously thought attentive acquaintance meant understanding everything encountered. You now end that formula: one object prompted a genuine question while others remain general impressions. **Ending a narrow form leaves a principle a path into personal depth.** Attentiveness can mean staying substantially with the question that arose. Each wants to think independently about a selected detail. Your view gains a subject for later conversation. Understanding remains valuable without an obligation to encompass the exhibition immediately or explain it identically to each other.

The risk is making depth in one question a new rule for proper acquaintance. A personal path again faces a compulsory form. Seeking a principle’s meaning leaves room for different experience. One detail mattered this time. Your view stays substantial when individual reflection can enrich shared conversation without requiring every other way of looking to be declared superficial.
